QUOTE: The post is written to the local DB before the network call, so it shows in the list while pending. ... If it throws, the code logs the error and builds an error post with `props.failed = true`. That post keeps its pending ID and is saved with `handlePosts`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both that the post is written locally before sending and that on failure it is kept and marked `failed = true`.
